text: POC, the Swedish maker of premium skiing and cycling helmets and protection gear, is a portfolio company of Investcorp, which lists POC (Stockholm, Sweden) among its investments, marked Acquired.
short: POC is a portfolio company of Investcorp.

source.name: Investcorp portfolio page: POC
source.note: The page is Investcorp's own portfolio entry for POC, marked 'Acquired'; it also describes POC as 'Established in 2005 in Stockholm, Sweden, POC is a leading manufacturer of premium skiing and cycling helmets, apparel, and accessories'. Unquote reported the acquisition from Black Diamond in 2015; Investcorp's page shows 2019.

additionalSources.name: Unquote: Investcorp launches POC Sports exit; Rothschild advises
additionalSources.quote: Investcorp acquired POC Sports from Black Diamond in 2015, financing the deal with all equity, as reported.
additionalSources.note: Independent confirmation that Investcorp bought POC and was still its owner when the exit process was reported in February 2022.
